title: 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Family Superpowers
description: Учим членов семьи, глагол can (уметь, мочь), объектные и притяжательные местоимения. Уровень A0. 6 дней.

grammar.title: Family Members
grammar.rule:
Вот основные члены семьи на английском:

👨 father (dad) — папа
👩 mother (mum) — мама
👨 brother — брат
👩 sister — сестра
👴 grandfather (grandpa) — дедушка
👵 grandmother (grandma) — бабушка
👨 uncle — дядя
👩 aunt — тётя
👨 cousin — двоюродный брат/сестра

🎯 Вопрос: Who is this? — Кто это?
🎯 Ответ: This is my mother.
examples: Leo: 'My father can fix anything. My mother can find anything I lose.' 🔧🔍
Mia: 'My sister can annoy me in 5 seconds. It's a superpower!' 😤
Sam: 'My grandma can bake the best cookies in the world. My grandpa can eat them all.' 🍪
grammar.keywords: father, mother, brother, sister, grandfather, grandmother, uncle, aunt, cousin

vocabulary.example: My father works in an office.
My mother cooks dinner every day.
vocabulary.context_example: Моя мама готовит ужин каждый день.

vocabulary.example: My brother plays video games all day.
vocabulary.context_example: Мой брат играет в видеоигры весь день.

vocabulary.example: My sister borrows my clothes without asking.
vocabulary.context_example: Моя сестра берёт мою одежду без спроса.

exercises.question: Who is your mother's husband? 👨
exercises.explanation: Mother's husband = father — папа! 👨

exercises.question: Who is your father's father? 👴
exercises.explanation: Father's father = grandfather — дедушка! 👴

exercises.question: My mother's sister is my ___ .
exercises.explanation: Mother's sister = aunt — тётя! 👩

exercises.question: My father's brother is my ___ .
exercises.explanation: Father's brother = uncle — дядя! 👨

exercises.question: Your sister's daughter is your cousin.
exercises.explanation: Sister's daughter is your niece, not cousin! 👧

grammar.title: Can — Ability
grammar.rule:
Глагол can используется, чтобы сказать, ЧТО ТЫ УМЕЕШЬ ДЕЛАТЬ.

✅ Утверждение: I can swim. / She can dance.
❌ Отрицание: I can't swim. / He cannot swim.
❓ Вопрос: Can you swim? — Yes, I can. / No, I can't.

🎯 Лайфхак: После can всегда идёт глагол без to!
❌ I can to swim (НЕПРАВИЛЬНО!)
✅ I can swim (ПРАВИЛЬНО!)

🎯 Мем: 'I can sleep for 10 hours. I can't wake up for school.' 😴
examples: Leo: 'I can play chess, but I can't win against my dad.' ♟️
Mia: 'My sister can draw amazing cartoons. I can only draw stick figures.' 🎨
Sam: 'I can eat pizza every day. My mum can't stop me!' 🍕
grammar.keywords: can, can't, cannot, ability, I can, she can

vocabulary.context_example: Мой брат умеет играть на гитаре.

vocabulary.example: Leo can play games for hours.
vocabulary.context_example: Лео может играть в игры часами.

exercises.question: Which sentence is correct? 🏊
exercises.explanation: After 'can' we use the verb without 'to'! ✅ I can swim, ❌ I can to swim

exercises.question: Choose the correct negative form: I ___ play the piano. 🎹
exercises.explanation: can't = cannot — отрицательная форма!

exercises.question: She ___ draw very well. (can / can't)
exercises.explanation: She can draw — она умеет рисовать! 🎨

exercises.question: I ___ (not) play football. I'm terrible at it! ⚽
exercises.explanation: I can't play football — я не умею играть в футбол!

exercises.question: 'Can you swim?' — 'Yes, I can.' is correct.
exercises.explanation: Yes, that's the correct short answer! 👍

days.title: Day 3: Object Pronouns (me, him, her, us, them)

grammar.title: Object Pronouns
grammar.rule:
Объектные местоимения отвечают на вопросы КОГО? ЧЕМУ? и используются ПОСЛЕ глагола или предлога.

📌 I → me (меня, мне)
📌 you → you (тебя, тебе)
📌 he → him (его, ему)
📌 she → her (её, ей)
📌 it → it (его, ему — для предметов)
📌 we → us (нас, нам)
📌 they → them (их, им)

🎯 Примеры:
✅ Call me later. — Позвони мне позже.
✅ I like her. — Она мне нравится.
✅ Give it to him. — Отдай это ему.

🎯 Мем: 'My mum asks me to clean my room. I don't listen to her. She doesn't give up on me.' 🧹
examples: Leo: 'My dad helps me with homework. I love him for that.' 📚
Mia: 'My sister annoys her. But I still love her.' 👧
Sam: 'My grandparents visit us every Sunday. We cook dinner for them.' 🍽️
grammar.keywords: me, him, her, us, them, object pronouns

exercises.question: I like my brother. I like ___ . 👨
exercises.explanation: brother — he → him!

exercises.question: This is for you and me. This is for ___ . 👥
exercises.explanation: you and me = we → us!

exercises.question: My grandmother calls ___ every Sunday. (me / us)
exercises.explanation: Me — мне (бабушка звонит МНЕ) 👵

exercises.question: The teacher gives homework to ___ . (we / us)
exercises.explanation: To us — нам (учитель даёт домашку НАМ) 📚

exercises.question: I love she.
exercises.explanation: После глагола love нужно her, не she! 💕

days.title: Day 4: Possessive Adjectives vs Object Pronouns

grammar.title: Possessive Adjectives vs Object Pronouns
grammar.rule:
Важно не путать! 🎯

📌 Possessive adjectives (чей?): my, your, his, her, its, our, their
→ Они всегда ПЕРЕД существительным: my phone, her room

📌 Object pronouns (кому? кого?): me, you, him, her, it, us, them
→ Они ПОСЛЕ глагола или предлога: call me, give her

🎯 Примеры:
✅ This is MY book. (чей? — мой)
✅ Give the book to ME. (кому? — мне)

🎯 Мем: 'This is MY pizza. Don't take it from ME.' 🍕
examples: Leo: 'This is MY computer. My dad gave it to ME.' 💻
Mia: 'HER room is a mess. I help HER clean it.' 🛏️
Sam: 'OUR fridge is empty. Mum told US to go shopping.' 🧊
grammar.keywords: my/me, your/you, his/him, her/her, our/us, their/them

exercises.question: This is ___ phone. (I / my / me)
exercises.explanation: My phone — мой телефон! 📱

exercises.question: Give the book to ___ . (I / my / me)
exercises.explanation: Give to me — дай МНЕ! 📖

exercises.question: That is ___ car. (they / their / them)
exercises.explanation: Their car — их машина! 🚗

exercises.question: I like ___ . (she / her)
exercises.explanation: I like her — она мне нравится! 💕

exercises.question: This is me book.
exercises.explanation: My book — моя книга, не me book! 📚

grammar.title: Revision: Family, Can, Object Pronouns, Possessive Adjectives
grammar.rule:
Сегодня проверяем себя! 🎯

📌 Члены семьи: mother, father, brother, sister, grandmother, grandfather
📌 Can: I can swim. She can't dance. Can you sing?
📌 Объектные местоимения: me, him, her, us, them
📌 Притяжательные: my, your, his, her, our, their

🎯 Структура: My sister can help me with homework.
examples: My brother can play guitar. I listen to him every day. 🎸
Our grandmother can bake cookies. She makes them for us. 🍪
Their father can fix anything. They ask him for help. 🔧
grammar.keywords: revision, family, can, object pronouns, possessive adjectives

exercises.question: My sister can draw. I like ___ drawings. 🎨
exercises.explanation: Her drawings — её рисунки! 🎨

exercises.question: My brother can play football. I play with ___ . ⚽
exercises.explanation: Play with him — играть с НИМ!

exercises.question: ___ (We / Us) mother can cook pizza. 🍕
exercises.explanation: Our mother — наша мама!

exercises.question: I can't find my keys. Can you help ___ ? (I / me)
exercises.explanation: Help me — помоги МНЕ! 🔑

exercises.question: My sister ___ (can / can't) sing. She's terrible! 🎤
exercises.explanation: Can't — не умеет! 🎤😱

exercises.question: My brother can to swim very well.
exercises.correct: My brother can swim very well.
exercises.explanation: После can НЕ нужен to! 🏊

days.title: Day 6: Reading — The Family Talent Show
days.description: Читаем смешную историю о семейном конкурсе талантов

grammar.title: Reading: The Family Talent Show
grammar.rule: Сегодня читаем историю о том, как семья устроила конкурс талантов. Кто что умеет? Используем can и местоимения!
grammar.keywords: reading, family, talent show, can, pronouns

exercises.question: What can Leo do? 🎮
exercises.explanation: Leo says: 'I can beat the final boss in any game!'
exercises.readingText:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎭 THE FAMILY TALENT SHOW
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📍 SCENE: The Johnson family living room. Everyone is gathered.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

MUM: 'Let's have a family talent show! Everyone shows what they can do!'

DAD: 'Great idea! I'll be the judge.'

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

LEO: 'I can beat the final boss in any video game! Watch me!'

(Leo plays for 30 seconds. His character dies.)

DAD: 'You can't even beat the first level, Leo.'

LEO: 'The controller is broken!' 🎮

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

MIA: 'I can draw! Look!' (shows a drawing)

DAD: 'Is that a cat?'

MIA: 'It's a dragon! 🐉'

DAD: '... Okay.'

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

SAM: 'I can eat a whole pizza in 3 minutes! Watch me!'

(Sam eats pizza. It takes 5 minutes. He needs a break.)

DAD: 'You can't do it, Sam.'

SAM: 'I can try again!' 🍕

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

GRANDMA: 'I can knit a sweater in one hour!'

(Everyone waits. Grandma knits. It's beautiful.)

DAD: 'Grandma wins!'

GRANDMA: 'Thank you, dear. Now who wants a sweater?' 🧣

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

LEO: 'Wait! I have one more talent! I can fall asleep anywhere! Watch me!'

(Leo lies on the sofa. He falls asleep in 10 seconds. Snoring.) 😴

MIA: 'That's not a talent, Leo.'

SAM: 'But it's impressive.'

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

DAD: 'The winner is Grandma! She can knit the best sweaters!'

GRANDMA: 'And I can knit one for everyone!'

EVERYONE: 'Yay!'

LEO: (wakes up) 'Did I win?'

EVERYONE: 'No, Leo.'

LEO: 'Can I go back to sleep?'

DAD: 'Yes, you can.' 😴

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
